name: Paid Work Experience for Ages 14 to 24 (Utah Workforce Services)
what_you_do: Paid internships help you try out careers and build skills. An employment counselor gives coaching, a career check and money support. The goal can be on-the-job training that leads to a lasting job.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 24. The apply page says the help is for youth who are out of school and struggling to connect to work or school, or who struggle at school or work. A counselor decides if you qualify.
pay_detail: The page says paid internships. The pay rate is not stated on the program page.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: The program page does not list a deadline.
how_to_apply: Apply online or at a local Employment Center. A counselor contacts you within three business days. You then send the papers they ask for within 45 days. Together you make a job plan.
notes: This is a state program with eligibility checks, so not every teen qualifies. You need a Utah ID account to apply online. The program page does not say which employers or pay rates are used.
